import copy
import gzip
import json
import unittest

from solution import (
    batch_items, columns_to_records, decode_records, encode_records,
    first_items, quantile_positions, unbatch_items,
)


class CollectionUtilityTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_batching_deep_copies_and_partial_batch(self):
        items = [{"x": [1]}, {"x": [2]}, {"x": [3]}]
        before = copy.deepcopy(items)
        result = batch_items(items, 2)
        self.assertEqual(result, [[{"x": [1]}, {"x": [2]}], [{"x": [3]}]])
        result[0][0]["x"].append(9)
        self.assertEqual(items, before)
        self.assertEqual(batch_items([], 2), [])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            batch_items(items, 2, strict=True)
        self.assertEqual(batch_items(items[:2], 2, strict=True), [[{"x": [1]}, {"x": [2]}]])

    def test_batch_validation(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            batch_items((), 1)
        for size in [True, 1.0, "1"]:
            with self.subTest(size=size):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    batch_items([], size)
        for size in [0, -1]:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                batch_items([], size)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            batch_items([], 1, 1)

    def test_unbatch_and_first_items(self):
        batches = [[{"v": [1]}, 2], [{"v": [3]}]]
        flat = unbatch_items(batches)
        first = first_items(batches)
        self.assertEqual(flat, [{"v": [1]}, 2, {"v": [3]}])
        self.assertEqual(first, [{"v": [1]}, {"v": [3]}])
        flat[0]["v"].append(8)
        first[1]["v"].append(9)
        self.assertEqual(batches, [[{"v": [1]}, 2], [{"v": [3]}]])
        self.assertEqual(unbatch_items([]), [])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            unbatch_items([("x",)])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            first_items([("x",)])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            first_items([[]])

    def test_columns_to_records(self):
        columns = {"a": [[1], [2]], "b": ["x", "y"]}
        before = copy.deepcopy(columns)
        rows = columns_to_records(columns)
        self.assertEqual(rows, [{"a": [1], "b": "x"}, {"a": [2], "b": "y"}])
        rows[0]["a"].append(9)
        self.assertEqual(columns, before)
        self.assertEqual(columns_to_records({}), [])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            columns_to_records([])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            columns_to_records({"a": (1,)})
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            columns_to_records({1: []})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            columns_to_records({"": []})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            columns_to_records({"a": [1], "b": []})

    def test_quantile_positions(self):
        self.assertEqual(quantile_positions(0, 4), [])
        self.assertEqual(quantile_positions(1, 4), [0, 0, 0, 0])
        self.assertEqual(quantile_positions(5, 3), [0, 2, 4])
        self.assertEqual(quantile_positions(3, 5), [0, 0, 1, 1, 2])
        for length, parts in [(True, 2), (2, False), (1.0, 2), (2, "3")]:
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                quantile_positions(length, parts)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            quantile_positions(-1, 2)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            quantile_positions(1, 1)

    def test_encode_is_deterministic_json_lines_gzip(self):
        records = [{"z": [1, {"b": True}], "a": "é"}, {"n": None}]
        before = copy.deepcopy(records)
        first = encode_records(records)
        second = encode_records(records)
        self.assertIsInstance(first, bytes)
        self.assertEqual(first, second)
        decoded_text = gzip.decompress(first).decode("utf-8")
        expected = "".join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True) + "\n" for row in records)
        self.assertEqual(decoded_text, expected)
        self.assertEqual(records, before)
        self.assertEqual(decode_records(first), records)

    def test_encode_validation_and_alias_independence(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            encode_records(())
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            encode_records([[]])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            encode_records([{"bad": {1, 2}}])
        source = [{"nested": [1]}]
        decoded = decode_records(encode_records(source))
        decoded[0]["nested"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(source, [{"nested": [1]}])

    def test_decode_bytes_like_empty_and_failures(self):
        payload = encode_records([{"a": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(decode_records(bytearray(payload)), [{"a": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(decode_records(memoryview(payload)), [{"a": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(decode_records(gzip.compress(b"", mtime=0)), [])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            decode_records("not bytes")
        malformed = [
            b"not gzip",
            gzip.compress(b"\xff", mtime=0),
            gzip.compress(b"{bad}\n", mtime=0),
            gzip.compress(b"{}\n\n{}\n", mtime=0),
            gzip.compress(b"[]\n", mtime=0),
        ]
        for data in malformed:
            with self.subTest(data=data):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    decode_records(data)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
